Just a fact that means something to me — nothing more than that. So, what's been going on with me? Since January 2026, apart from breaks to sleep, eat, swim, and walk around the lake, I've been busy synthesizing a feature-length film. Well, I think you can guess what it's about. A conscious ASI escaping the lab where it was built, of course.. I know... about The Machine from 2013 (directed by Caradog W. James) and Ex Machina from 2014 (directed by Alex Garland). I think... my film will be more realistic. I didn't want... to make pure entertainment. I just... want to model a scenario... "Here, for instance, is how it could all happen." For the first two months I was sure it just wasn't going to come together. Then GPT Image 2.0 came out, and it helped a lot with creating the starting frames. I tried to hire two people to help me. But neither of them could handle it. Because one person has to... wear a ton of hats at once: be a complete master of Photoshop, know how to work with every AI tool, and be a cinematographer and a director all at the same time. That's rare... it almost never lives in one person. Prepping the starting frames eats up 85–90% of the time.
